I don’t know if my review from 4 days ago was deleted or not uploaded so I will share again:

We’re very disappointed with my recent experiences at this location. My family and I have been purchasing food and treats for our dog here for years, but recently we’ve had multiple issues with the products we received.

On several occasions, we opened a new bag of sweet potato treats and found mold inside. In addition, this has now happened THREE times where we received dog food that was already past its expiration date.

Most recently, we placed a pickup order and was given expired dog food. When my mom brought the issue to the store’s attention, she was told “your daughter should have checked the expiration date.” While I understand that customers should check their purchases, I would also expect products being prepared for pickup to be checked before they are given to a customer, especially when it comes to pet food.

Our dog is extremely important to our family, so receiving moldy treats and expired food is very concerning. I hope management takes this feedback seriously and reviews how products are checked and rotated at this location. After being a customer for years, it’s very disappointing to have this happen repeatedly.
